description: Runs the Model Report plugin's fourteen quality checks on the open CIVIL NX model: duplicate (coincident) nodes, orphan nodes, zero-length and duplicate elements, elements without material/section, unused properties, disconnected regions, support adequacy, load cases with no loads, loads on missing nodes/elements, combinations citing a missing case, elements in no structure group, length outliers and end releases that make a mechanism. Returns each check's result (pass / fail / not applicable / not run), severity, criterion, count and the ids involved, a model summary (counts, units) and what was read from each table. Reads only the tables the checks use (GET only). Read-only; on the website it runs as a job.

language.description: Language of the check wording / the report: English, French, German, Greek, Polish.

outlierFactor.description: An element longer or shorter than the median length by this factor is an outlier.

toleranceMm.description: Nodes closer than this (mm, 3D) count as coincident.

name: model_qc_check
title: Model QC checks (Model Report)
